summary: Dorothy Maskell worked in Buddhist studies and Indology. She succeeded William Stede and served as Reader of Pāli at SOAS University of London from 1949 to 1956.

Douglas Allen is a scholar of philosophy and religious studies who earned degrees from Yale, Banaras Hindu, and Vanderbilt universities. He taught at Middle Tennessee State, SIU Carbondale, Central Connecticut State, and the University of Maine, becoming Professor Emeritus in 2020.

Douglas Barrett was an Indology and archaeology scholar educated in Classics at the University of Oxford and at SOAS University of London. He joined the British Museum in 1947, served as Curator from 1969 to 1977, and became a British Academy Fellow in 1976.

Douglas Craven Phillott worked in linguistics, Indology, and history and archaeology, having studied at Felsted School and the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst. In 1912 he became Lecturer in Urdu and Hindustani at Gonville and Caius College, and was attested as a Fellow of The Asiatic Society in 1927.

Douglas Gildow specializes in Buddhist studies, sinology, and religious studies. After completing his PhD at Princeton University under Stephen F. Teiser and Qi Zhou, he held posts at City College of New York, Florida State University, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Douglas J. Penick is an author in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Princeton University from circa 1962 to 1966 and trained under traditional teacher Chögyam Trungpa beginning in 1971.

Douglas L. Berger is a scholar of philosophy, sinology, and Indology. He held an assistant professorship at Southern Illinois University Carbondale, served as General Editor for Dimensions of Asian Spirituality, and was appointed Professor and Centre Director at Leiden University.

Douglas Ober works in Buddhist studies, history and archaeology, and Indology. He studied at the University of Washington under teachers including Charles Keyes and Richard G. Salomon, and completed his PhD at the University of British Columbia under Harjot Oberoi.

Douglas Osto is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at Grinnell, Harvard, the University of Washington, and SOAS under Ulrich Pagel. He began teaching at Massey University in 2005, becoming Senior Lecturer circa 2007.

Douglas Q. Adams is a scholar of linguistics, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Indology. He completed his studies at the University of Chicago by 1972 and held a post at the University of Idaho circa 1974.

Douglas S. Duckworth is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Tibetology who studied at James Madison University and the University of Virginia under Jeffrey Hopkins, alongside numerous traditional teachers. He has taught at the Rangjung Yeshe Institute and East Tennessee State University.
Dragana Majhen is a scholar of religious and Buddhist studies who earned a Master's degree at the University of Manitoba under the supervision of Albert Welter.

Dragomir Dimitrov specializes in Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology. He earned his degrees at the University of Marburg under Michael Hahn, held academic posts there and with the Nepalese-German Manuscript Cataloguing Project, and served as Foreign Adjunct Professor at Savitribai Phule Pune University.

Dramdul is a scholar in Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He served as Director of the China Tibetology Research Center from 2004 to 2012 and as editor-in-chief of Sanskrit Texts from the Tibetan Autonomous Region.
Drodul Dorji Tenzin studied under Dudjom Rinpoche and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.

Drodul Pawo Dorje studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Ayu Khandro, and Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen.
Drolkar Chungchung studied under Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo and Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye.
Drolma is a scholar of Tibetology who completed an M. Phil in Tibetan Studies at the University of Oslo under the supervision of Hanna Havnevik.
Drubwang Shakya Shri studied under Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso, and taught Lobsang Phuntshok Lhalungpa.

id: P:Drukpa Ku Chen Chöying Rolwé Dorjé
summary: Drukpa Ku Chen Chöying Rolwé Dorjé studied under Patrul Rinpoche and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso, and taught Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang.
